questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This checks secure local data handling, key management, and basic SwiftUI patterns for a beginner role.

## Key Concepts
- On-device encryption with CryptoKit
- Keychain-stored encryption keys
- Biometric authentication with LocalAuthentication
- Codable persistence to Documents
- SwiftUI List + Detail editing, simple search
- Basic test plan coverage

## Code Example
```swift
import CryptoKit
struct Note: Codable { let id: UUID; let title: String; let body: String; let createdAt: Date; var isLocked: Bool }
func encrypt(_ data: Data, with key: SymmetricKey) -> Data { let sealed = try AES.GCM.seal(data, using: key); return sealed.combined! }
func decrypt(_ data: Data, with key: SymmetricKey) throws -> Data { let box = try AES.GCM.SealedBox(combined: data); return try AES.GCM.open(box, using: key) }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle key rotation and data migration?
- How would you test biometric edge cases and offline scenarios?

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design resilient, real-time data pipelines on iOS, balancing bursts from networks with smooth UI rendering. Evaluates data modeling, local caching, and crash-safe resume.

## Key Concepts

- Backpressure and throttling in streaming pipelines
- Disk-backed caching with sane eviction
- Ordering, idempotency, and replay on relaunch
- Combine/async patterns for performance
- Crash-safe state persistence and resume

## Code Example

```swift
struct Location { let latitude: Double; let longitude: Double }
struct Vehicle { let id: String; var lastLocation: Location; var lastSeq: Int; var lastTs: TimeInterval }
struct UpdateEnvelope { let seq: Int; let vehicleId: String; let location: Location; let ts: TimeInterval }
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test memory usage and confirm no leaks during bursts?
- How would you simulate network partitions and verify correct replay after reconnect?
